feature: Delivery Requests link Sales Orders and Transfer Orders
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); user authorized the feature and existing session authorizes deployment

setup.git: Preserve unrelated workspace changes; no commits
setup.environment: Standard isolated Compose, mbbs-tests.slice and bounded resources; register teardown before startup; remove test containers, volumes and networks after every run
setup.release: Overlay only tested files onto the current live image; keep rollback image, preserve configuration and dependencies; no production data copied into tests

scenarios.behavior: Accept SO123, TO123 or a mixed list; trim and uppercase, deduplicate in input order, require 1–50 entries; reject PO, malformed and nontext inputs.
A retained, active TO can secure approval when the requesting yard equals its sending or receiving yard; missing, inactive, closed/rejected-family and unrelated-yard TOs cannot be linked.
Mixed-order linking and replacement is atomic. Invalid TOs preserve existing links, status, revision and events. Same-request concurrent edits have one winner; retries are idempotent.
TO-only approval stops expiry, retains the approved window and quote, supports time changes, and cancellation releases the links. The existing deadline and role/yard checks apply.
Linked TOs receive priority and approved time in normal and paginated Dispatch feeds; removing a link or cancelling restores the original window.

Both teams can preview a linked TO summary with reference, sending/receiving yard, memo and original Quantity/PLT/LYR/SEC/PCS. No prices, duplicate receiving-stage lines or retired lines. Unlinked/unauthorized previews are denied.

Sales can add, exchange and unlink SOs/TOs on desktop/mobile, retaining at least one order. Dispatch has no Sales edit controls. TO-only requests do not call Sales Order instruction endpoints; mixed requests retain SO instructions.

Keep existing SO linkage, native SO PDF preview, quantity-only EST preview, SO instruction editing, pricing, approval timing and notifications. Preserve the existing salesOrderRefs API/storage field and link table; no migration or NetSuite write.

failureModel.unauthorizedOrder: real database and HTTP tests for request audience, yard, missing/closed/inactive TOs and preview membership
failureModel.partialOrLostLink: database rollback, replay and concurrent revision tests
failureModel.wrongTimeslot: normal/paged planning tests, replacement and cancellation assertions
failureModel.invalidReference: hostile-input cases and fast-check normalization properties
failureModel.brokenInterface: browser tests with SO-only, TO-only and mixed links at desktop/mobile sizes
failureModel.silentRegression: complete Delivery Request and instruction regression suites, baseline comparison, static checks, changed-line coverage and manual mutations
failureModel.unsafeDeployment: exact image source hashes, configuration comparison, quiet-operation preflight, automatic rollback and public HTTP health checks
